Quick Add General Operating Expense

Rent, salaries, utilities, transport, etc.
How this is calculated
Gross Profit = Total Realized Sales − Total Purchases (COGS).
Net Profit = Gross Profit − Total Operating Expenses.
Pumice is accounted singularly and does not bleed into general COGS or sales.
Cash injections fund the business but are not counted as revenue or profit.
